title: Computer-Aided Rational Engineering of Signal Sensitivity of Quorum Sensing Protein LuxR in a Whole-Cell Biosensor.
authors: Li, Jinyu; Liu, Ruicun; Chen, Yulu; Liu, Shuxia; Chen, Cheng; Liu, Tuoyu; Yang, Shan; Zhuang, Yingtan; Yang, Ruifu; Cui, Yujun; Song, Yajun; Wang, Tao; Teng, Yue
one_liner_zh: 该文用MD和MM-GB/SA方法理性改造群体感应转录因子LuxR与信号分子的结合亲和力，虽涉及TF-配体而非TF-DNA互作，但MD/结合自由能方法可迁移至TF-DNA体系研究。
abstract: LuxR, a bacterial quorum sensing-related transcription factor that responds to the signaling molecule 3-oxo-hexanoyl-homoserine lactone (3OC6-HSL). In this study, we employed molecular dynamics simulation and the Molecular Mechanics Generalized Born Surface Area (MM-GB/SA) method to rationally identify residues in Vibrio fischeri LuxR that are important for its interaction with 3OC6-HSL. Isoleucine-46 was selected for engineering as the key residue for interaction with 3OC6-HSL-LuxR-I46F would have the strongest binding energy to 3OC6-HSL and LuxR-I46R the weakest binding energy. Stable wild-type (WT) LuxR, I46F and I46R variants were produced in Escherichia coli (E. coli) in the absence of 3OC6-HSL by fusion with maltose-binding protein (MBP). Dissociation constants for 3OC6-HSL from MBP-fusions of WT-, I46F- and I46R-LuxR determined by surface plasmon resonance confirmed the binding affinity. We designed and constructed a novel whole-cell biosensor on the basis of LuxR-I46F in E. coli host cells with a reporting module that expressed green fluorescent protein. The biosensor had high sensitivity in response to the signaling molecule 3OC6-HSL produced by the target bacterial pathogen Yersinia pestis. Our work demonstrates a practical, generalizable framework for the rational design and adjustment of LuxR-family proteins for use in bioengineering and bioelectronics applications.
abstract_zh: LuxR是一种细菌群体感应相关转录因子，响应信号分子3-氧代己酰基-高丝氨酸内酯（3OC6-HSL）。在本研究中，我们采用分子动力学模拟和分子力学广义Born表面积（MM-GB/SA）方法，理性识别费氏弧菌（Vibrio fischeri）LuxR中对其与3OC6-HSL相互作用至关重要的残基。异亮氨酸-46被选为与3OC6-HSL相互作用的关键残基进行工程改造——LuxR-I46F对3OC6-HSL具有最强的结合能，而LuxR-I46R具有最弱的结合能。稳定的野生型（WT）LuxR、I46F和I46R变体在无3OC6-HSL条件下，通过融合麦芽糖结合蛋白（MBP）在大肠杆菌（E. coli）中生产。通过表面等离子体共振测定的WT-、I46F-和I46R-LuxR的MBP融合蛋白与3OC6-HSL的解离常数确认了结合亲和力。我们设计并构建了一种基于LuxR-I46F的新型全细胞生物传感器，以大肠杆菌宿主细胞为基础，并带有表达绿色荧光蛋白的报告模块。该生物传感器对目标细菌病原体鼠疫耶尔森菌（Yersinia pestis）产生的信号分子3OC6-HSL具有高灵敏度响应。我们的工作展示了一种实用且可推广的框架，用于理性设计和调整LuxR家族蛋白，以应用于生物工程和生物电子学领域。
